documents.title: Reference letter
documents.issued_by: Head of Analytics, Nirmal Retail Analytics
documents.text: Priya Raghunathan worked in my team from March 2023 to June 2026. She independently designed and maintained our weekly sales reporting pipeline, including validation checks that caught duplicate transactions before they reached finance. She led the analysis of our 2025 festive promotions and presented her findings to the regional leadership group, who adopted two of her recommendations. She followed our data privacy policy carefully when handling customer loyalty data.
